ASIA

SOUTHEAST ASIA

#### Indonesia

  • It is a country with highest Muslim population around the world.
  • Capital: Nusantara (old capital: Jakarta)
  • Five main islands in Indonesia: Sumatra (largest island of all), Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Java, Papua.
  • Most of the islands in Indonesia are volcanic islands.
CountryCapital
MalaysiaKuala Lumpur
ThailandBangkok
VietnamHanoi
MyanmarNaypyidaw
LaosVientiane
CambodiaPhnom Penh
East TimorDili
PhilippinesManila
  • Myanmar was earlier known as "Burma".
  • Laos is a landlocked country (only surrounded by land and no ocean).

Strait

  • A strait is a narrow passage of water body that connects two large bodies of water or separates two landmasses.

#### Strait of Malacca

  • It connects South China Sea (part of Pacific Ocean) and Andaman Sea (part of Indian Ocean) and separates Malaysia and Indonesia.

#### Sunda Strait

  • It connects the Java Sea and the Indian Ocean and separates the Indonesian islands of Sumatra and Java.

EAST ASIA

#### China

  • Capital: Beijing
  • Desert: Taklamakan (largest desert of China) and Gobi Desert (China and Mongolia) (cold desert).

#### Japan

  • Capital: Tokyo
  • Honshu island is the largest island of Japan.

#### South Korea

  • Capital: Seoul
  • It shares border with North Korea.

#### North Korea

  • Capital: Pyongyang
  • It shares borders with China and Russia.

South and North Korea are separated by 38th Parallel.

#### Taiwan

  • Capital: Taipei
  • Taiwan was earlier known as Formosa.

#### Yellow Sea

  • It is located between mainland China and Korean Peninsula.

#### Kuril Islands

  • This island under territorial dispute between Japan and Russia.

SOUTHWEST ASIA

(Map 3: Southwest Asia) — Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Yemen, Turkiye, Azerbaijan, Lebanon, Jordan, Iran, etc.

#### Saudi Arabia

  • Capital: Riyadh

#### Iraq

  • Capital: Baghdad
  • Old name of Iraq: Mesopotamia
  • It is referred to as "the land between two rivers" → Tigris and Euphrates rivers.

#### Turkiye

  • Capital: Ankara
  • It is spread across two continents: Europe and Asia
  • Currency: Lira

#### Yemen

  • Capital: Sana'a

#### Lebanon

  • Capital: Beirut

#### Jordan

  • Capital: Amman

CENTRAL ASIA

CountryCapital

Liechtenstein and Uzbekistan are the only doubly landlocked countries (countries that are surrounded by landlocked countries).

SOUTH ASIA

  • Old name of Iran: Persia

Straits

#### Kerch Strait

  • It connects the Black Sea and the Sea of Azov and separates Kerch (in Ukraine) and Russia.

#### Bosphorus Strait (corrected: Bosphorous → Bosphorus)

  • It connects the Black Sea to the Sea of Marmara.

#### Strait of Hormuz

  • It connects the Persian Gulf (west) to the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea (in the southeast).

#### Bab-al-Mandab Strait

  • This strait is also known as Gateway of Grief or the Gate of Tears.
  • It connects the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden.

#### Palk Strait

  • It connects the Bay of Bengal to Gulf of Mannar and separates India and Sri Lanka.

Sea

#### Caspian Sea

  • It is surrounded by five countries (TRICK: TRACK — Turkmenistan, Russia, Azerbaijan, Iran, Kazakhstan) (corrected: Iraq → Iran; Caspian does NOT border Iraq).
  • Caspian Sea is a lake and is a landlocked water body of Europe and Asia.
  • Rivers Volga, Ural, and Terek discharge themselves into the Caspian Sea.

#### Black Sea

  • It is bordered by six countries: Bulgaria, Georgia, Romania, Russia, Turkiye, and Ukraine (TRICK: The BuRGUR).
  • Rivers Danube, Dnieper, and Dniester discharge themselves into the Black Sea.

#### Red Sea

  • It is bordered by six countries: Djibouti, Eritrea, Saudi Arabia, Sudan, Egypt, Yemen (TRICK: DESSEY).

#### Dead Sea

  • It is a salt water lake with highest salinity in the world (salinity: 34.2%).
  • It is bordered by two main countries: Jordan and Israel.

TRANS-SIBERIAN RAIL LINK

  • It is world's longest rail link with the length of 9288 km.
  • It connects Vladivostok and Siberia.

#### Russia

  • Capital: Moscow
  • It is a trans-continental country.

#### Ukraine

  • Capital: Kyiv

Canal

  • It is an artificial waterway constructed to allow the passage of boats or ships inland or to convey water for irrigation.

#### Suez Canal

  • It connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea.

AFRICA

  • It is known as "Continent of Continents", "Dark Continent", and "Black Continent".
  • It is the only continent from where all three important latitudes pass (Equator, Tropic of Cancer, Tropic of Capricorn).

#### Ethiopia

  • Capital: Addis Ababa
  • Old name of Ethiopia: Abyssinia

#### Malawi

  • Capital: Lilongwe
  • Old name of Malawi: Nyasaland

#### Zimbabwe

  • Capital: Harare

#### Egypt

  • Capital: Cairo
  • It is a transcontinental country.

#### Zambia

  • Capital: Lusaka

Zimbabwe and Zambia were previously known as Rhodesia.

Mountain Ranges and Peaks

#### Atlas

  • It is a series of mountain ranges located in Northern Africa.

#### Mt. Kilimanjaro

  • It is a dormant volcano and the highest peak of Africa (in Tanzania).

Desert

#### Sahara Desert

  • It is world's largest hot desert spanning across North Africa.

#### Kalahari Desert

  • It is located in Southern Africa covering Botswana, Namibia, and South Africa.

#### Namib Desert

  • It is located in west coast of Southern Africa covering Namibia, Angola, and South Africa.

Great Rift Valley

  • The Great Rift Valley is a series of continuous geographical trench that features the deepest lakes and highest mountains.
  • It is one of the most extensive rifts on the Earth's surface that runs along the part of East Africa.

River

#### Nile River

  • It is the longest river of the world.
  • It is formed from Blue Nile (origin: Lake Tana in Ethiopia) and White Nile (origin: Lake Victoria of Tanzania).
  • The Nile river empties at Mediterranean Sea.

#### Congo River

  • It cuts the equator twice.

#### Limpopo River

  • It cuts the Tropic of Capricorn twice.

NORTH AMERICA

#### Alaska

  • It was earlier a part of Russia.

#### Greenland

  • It is the largest island of the world located in North Atlantic Ocean.

Canal and Strait

#### Panama Canal

  • Panama Canal links North America to South America and separates the Atlantic Ocean from the Pacific Ocean.

#### Bering Strait

  • Bering strait connects Arctic Ocean to Pacific Ocean and separates Asia and North America.

#### 49th Parallel Line

  • It is a boundary between USA and Canada.

Mountains

#### Rocky Mountains

  • They are also known as Rockies. They are the largest and major mountain range in North America.
  • They are young fold mountains.

#### Appalachian Mountains

  • They are among the oldest mountain ranges on Earth.
  • They are old fold mountains.

#### Desert

  • Mojave desert and Sonoran desert.

Peak

  • Mt. Mckinley (also called as Mt. Denali) is the highest peak of North America.

CANADA

  • Canadas has the most no. of natural lakes in the world.

The Great Lakes (HOMES):

  • H: Lake Huron
  • O: Lake Ontario
  • M: Lake Michigan
  • E: Lake Erie
  • S: Lake Superior (world's largest freshwater lake)

These lakes are known as "The Great Lakes" and are shared by both USA and Canada.

SOUTH AMERICA

CountryCapital
ChileSantiago
ArgentinaBuenos Aires
ParaguayAsuncion
BoliviaSucre
UruguayMontevideo
BrazilBrasilia
VenezuelaCaracas
  • Brazil Currency: Brazilian Real

Mountains

#### Ojos del Salado (corrected: Ojas → Ojos)

  • It is the highest mountain (dormant complex volcano) in the Andes range on Argentina-Chile border.

#### Mt. Cotopaxi

  • It is located in the Andes mountains of Ecuador.

Andes Mountain Range

  • It is the longest chain of mountain range on land that runs along the western coast of South America. It is a young fold mountain range.
  • It passes through seven countries: Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, Chile, and Argentina.

#### Mt. Aconcagua

  • It is the highest peak (6960 m) of Andes.
  • It is located in Argentina.

#### Atacama Desert

  • It is the driest desert located in Northern Chile bordered by Pacific Ocean (west) and Andes Mountains (east).

Alps Mountain Range

  • The Alps are the highest mountain range in Europe and are young fold mountains.

Scandinavian Countries and Nordic Countries

  • Scandinavian countries: Norway, Sweden, Denmark
  • Nordic countries: Denmark, Finland, Sweden, Norway, Iceland

Hindenburg Line (corrected: Hidenburg → Hindenburg)

  • It is a line between Germany and Poland (German defensive line in French territory during World War I).

EUROPE

#### Russia

  • Russia is considered a part of both Europe and Asia.
  • Mt. Elbrus (5642 m) is the highest peak of Russia and Europe.

Mountain Ranges

#### Ural Mountain Ranges

  • It separates Europe and Asia and is an old fold mountain range.

OCEANIA

  • Oceania is made up of Micronesia, Polynesia, and Melanesia, in addition to Australasia, which includes Australia and New Zealand.

River

  • The longest river of Australia is Murray.

Strait

#### Bass Strait

  • It separates Tasmania from Victoria in Australia.

Great Barrier Reef

  • It is the world's largest barrier reef located in North Eastern coast of Australia.
  • It is also the world's largest coral reef system.

Desert

#### Great Australian Desert

  • The Great Australian Desert covers central and western Australia.
  • It is made up of several interconnected deserts, making it the largest in Australia.

ARCTIC AND ANTARCTICA

ANTARCTICA

  • Highest Peak: Mt. Vinson Massif
  • Indian Research Centre in Antarctica: Bharati, Dakshin Gangotri (established in 1984), and Maitri.

ARCTIC

  • India's first research centre "Himadri" was established here in 2008.
